summary: Reproduced the independent review against candidate f7d3ecf: its bounded MXFP4 registered-test supervisor and advisory-lock regressions are valid, a live _build_lock owner remains intentionally unbounded, and the self-test bypasses the real JIT path. Preserved the candidate unchanged and corrected provenance for the new delivery.

tests.what_was_measured: On exact candidate f7d3ecf, an injected first-worker stall was bounded, its process group was killed, and a second fresh-cache self-test worker succeeded; 1 passed in 34.15s.
On exact candidate f7d3ecf, a contender remained blocked while another live process owned _build_lock.
The actual registered worker reached hipcc for gfx950 and failed on missing NVIDIA header cuda_bf16.h; 4 tests ran, no MXFP4 kernel executed.
Post-integration JIT-cache regression suite: 45 passed in 38.59s.
Environment limitation: the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module; no source formatting failure was observed. Preserved candidate evidence records its prior successful ruff run.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 reached the real MXFP4 JIT hipcc command with --offload-arch=gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, but compilation stopped at missing cuda_bf16.h before any kernel execution.

remaining_limitations: The intermittent NVIDIA H200 stall was not statistically reproduced because only AMD gfx950 was assigned.
No MXFP4 GPU numerical execution occurred because the CUDA-specific source cannot compile in the ROCm environment.
The production _build_lock intentionally remains unbounded while its owner is alive; only the registered MXFP4 test process is supervised.
The deterministic supervisor regression validates supervisor mechanics and deliberately exits before the MXFP4 JIT/kernel path.
Ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter; the preserved exact candidate includes its earlier passing ruff evidence.
